title: Automatic Transcranial Sonography-Based Classification of Parkinson's Disease Using a Novel Dual-Channel CNXV2-DANet.
summary: Retrospective study of 588 subjects with transcranial sonography images classified for Parkinson's disease by a dual-channel CNXV2-DANet, evaluated on an independent test split. AI role: Dual-channel CNXV2-DANet deep-learning classifier. The article appeared in Bioengineering (Basel, Switzerland).
organization: Department of Biomedical Engineering, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong SAR, China.; Research Institute of Smart Ageing, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong SAR, China.; Department of Ultrasound, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing 100070, China.

evidence.tested: Retrospective study of 588 subjects with transcranial sonography images classified for Parkinson's disease by a dual-channel CNXV2-DANet, evaluated on an independent test split.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the described dataset, cohort, experimental system, or validation design; generalization beyond that scope and downstream real-world benefit are not established.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
